name: gate-driver-core-drive
description: End-to-end gate-driver signal chain (design/netlist/gate_driver_core.spice, issue #98): logic-in (IN) -> level_shifter -> output_stage -> 1 nF reference load, driven as one connected chain (not an isolated sub-cell) -- substantiates spec/gate-driver.md Sec.3's block-level drive targets end-to-end (issue #100).
analyses: meas tran trise10_90 TRIG v(OUT) VAL=outlo RISE=1 TARG v(OUT) VAL=outhi RISE=1
meas tran tfall10_90 TRIG v(OUT) VAL=outhi FALL=1 TARG v(OUT) VAL=outlo FALL=1
meas tran tpdlh TRIG v(IN) VAL=inmid RISE=1 TARG v(OUT) VAL=outmid RISE=1
meas tran tpdhl TRIG v(IN) VAL=inmid FALL=1 TARG v(OUT) VAL=outmid FALL=1

trise_s.description: spec Sec.3: 10-90% rise into 1nF reference load < 50ns, end-to-end IN->OUT

tfall_s.description: spec Sec.3: 10-90% fall into 1nF reference load < 50ns, end-to-end IN->OUT

ipeak_source_a.description: spec Sec.3: peak source current into 1nF load >= 0.5A (nominal target; the 1A stretch-rail target is evaluated separately in this record's narrative, not as a blanket harness check -- see sim/output-stage-drive/testbench/tb.json's identical convention)

ipeak_sink_a.description: spec Sec.3: peak sink current into 1nF load >= 0.5A (nominal target; see ipeak_source_a note on the 1A stretch target)

vout_max_v.description: sanity: OUT must not exceed the swept drive rail plus headroom (no uncontrolled overshoot source in this chain)

vout_min_v.description: sanity: OUT must not undershoot below GND_DRV
